<!-- pr-reviewer: ef83099b29d7bca512a786b84cb6b12f630e0f4f -->
**Needs changes before merge** (one process blocker: the issue reference).

Thanks, tbrasselle - the change itself looks clean.

**What looks good**
- Small, layered correctly (all in `crates/ui`, no app/flecs calls); `Gizmo.name` is filled in `gizmos()` so the Models-pane eye and `show_world_axes` gate carry over for free.
- No new `unwrap/expect/panic` outside tests (the ones in `law_tests.rs` are test code); no casts or indexing added; the origin projection is guarded by `project_uv`'s `Option`.
- No new toggle or state: labels are derived, so no command is needed. No icons, fonts, PNGs, dependencies, build.rs, scripts or .github files touched; no snapshot PNGs changed.
- Pins are named, the red-first story is documented, the decision file is in `docs/decisions/` (not RECOMMENDED.md), and there is no CHANGELOG.md edit. Clean-room: nothing derived from HSMWorks.

**Local results (merged with current upstream/main - already up to date, no conflicts)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test --lib` in `crates/ui` | 381 passed, 1 failed, 5 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The one failure is environmental (no GPU adapter on this review machine), not the PR:
```
egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds ... No suitable graphics adapter found
```
All gizmo_tests / axis_note_tests / setup_chip_tests passed.

**Requested before merge**
1. Wrong issue number. The title, body (`Fixes #641`), `Changelog:` line and `docs/decisions/641-viewport-gizmo-labels.md` all cite #641, but NeoTech/Camcraft #641 is "Lathe grooving/parting: blades post the centre of the width, but a blade is touched off on a corner - groove Z off by width/2" - unrelated. As written, merging would auto-close that open lathe bug. Please find (or file) the issue this really addresses, then fix the title, `Fixes #N`, the Changelog line, the decision file name/heading, and the `#641` mentions in the `interact.rs` comments. If there is no issue, use no closing keyword (e.g. `Refs`) and file one.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `interact.rs` (1781 lines) and `law_tests.rs` (2126 lines) were already far over the ~400-line guide; this adds ~35 and ~95 lines. Not blocking, but a split of the gizmo code later would help.
- The title says `feat(ui)`, so this ships at the next minor cut.
- The on-screen labels themselves were not visually checked here (nobody ran the GUI); the producers are pinned by tests.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
